Review Airtable?

Reviewers largely see Airtable as a flexible middle ground between spreadsheets and databases: easy for non-technical teammates to use, strong for collaboration, multiple views, templates, integrations, and custom workflows across project tracking, inventory, notes, and personal organization. A founder from Slashy specifically says that spreadsheet familiarity plus database structure made it a fit for customer workflows. The main complaints are practical: record and automation limits, slow performance on larger bases or even some views, a somewhat messy or less customizable interface, weak sharing/discovery, and one notably bad support experience.
